text:
maria: Quick heads-up — PR #1987 failing on e2e after artifact republish. Rebase window closes in ~3h. Can we pause merges and get eyes? :eyes:
jonathan: Which job is failing? link: https://ci.example.com/1987
maria: Failing step is `integration::payment-flow` on linux. Logs show missing artifact v2.4.3.
ci-bot: Artifact republish requested by maria. Starting publish...
ci-bot: Artifact v2.4.3 republish complete, checksum 0x9f3a. Triggering rebuild.
jonathan: Nice. Can we wait for the rebuild before doing any rebase? If it flakes again we'll need a quick revert plan.
sarah: I'll take a quick look at the failing test. @kevin can you give approval once green? Need one more approver for the PR.
kevin: I'm on PTO but can approve in 30m if it goes green. Ping me.
sarah: Rebuild jobs queued: `linux-integration`, `mac-e2e` — ETA ~12m.
ci-bot: linux-integration: passed. mac-e2e: running.
maria: Update: rebase window ends 3h from now; if mac passes we can land before deploy freeze tomorrow. Otherwise hold for scheduled rebase window next weekday.
jonathan: Suggest we hold merges for next 20m until mac is done, then decide. Anyone object?
kevin: No objections. If mac green I will approve and merge.
sarah: mac-e2e: passed :tada:
kevin: Approved. Landing now.
maria: Merged. Thanks all — will monitor post-deploy, will open a follow-up if we see regressions.
ci-bot: Deploy started to canary cluster. Track at https://deploys.example.com/12345
maria: Marking this thread resolved. :white_check_mark:
